Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 36 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Tanay stands in the snow. Anjali stands near him.]

Tanay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Anjali (excited): "I knew it!"

[Tanay builds a snowman.]

Anjali: "Tanay, listen!"

[Tanay catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Anjali (excited): "Let's see."

[Tanay slides down the snowy slope.]

Anjali: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Vikram stand near him.]

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[It starts to rain.]

Tanay: "What happened?"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Vikram: "Wow, how lovely!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Tanay (gently): "I knew it!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Anjali (softly): "Vikram, look at this."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Tanay (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Vikram: "Tanay, look at this."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
